tools.name: customer_list
tools.title: List Customers
tools.description: The customer directory: the way in to customers, their requests and their linked work items. GET /workspaces/{workspace}/customers.

tools.name: customer_retrieve
tools.title: Get Customers
tools.description: One customer by id, for the detail a listing narrows to. GET /workspaces/{workspace}/customers/{customer_id}.

tools.name: customer_list_workitems
tools.title: List Customers (work items)
tools.description: The work items filed against a customer, which is how customer work is actually tracked. GET /workspaces/{workspace}/customers/{customer_id}/issues. The work items linked to one customer; the vendor reaches it through its work-item resource.

tools.name: customer_property_list
tools.title: List Customer Properties
tools.description: The workspace's customer property definitions, needed to read any customer's values. GET /workspaces/{workspace}/customer-properties.

tools.name: customer_property_retrieve
tools.title: Get Customer Properties
tools.description: One property definition, including the options a value has to come from. GET /workspaces/{workspace}/customer-properties/{property_id}.

tools.name: customer_request_list
tools.title: List Customer Requests
tools.description: The requests a customer has raised: the queue that customer work starts from. GET /workspaces/{workspace}/customers/{customer_id}/requests.

tools.name: customer_request_retrieve
tools.title: Get Customer Requests
tools.description: One request, with the link and description a listing leaves out. GET /workspaces/{workspace}/customers/{customer_id}/requests/{request_id}.

tools.name: cycle_retrieve
tools.title: Get Cycles
tools.description: One cycle, whose dates and ownership the project's schedule is read from. GET /workspaces/{workspace}/projects/{project_id}/cycles/{cycle_id}.

tools.name: cycle_list_workitems
tools.title: List Cycles (work items)
tools.description: What is planned into a cycle: the reading that answers whether a sprint is on track. GET /workspaces/{workspace}/projects/{project_id}/cycles/{cycle_id}/cycle-issues. Work items filed in the cycle; the general work-item listing is a separate tool. `pql` is Plane's own query language for filtering and grouping.

tools.name: initiative_list
tools.title: List Initiatives
tools.description: The workspace's initiatives, the level above projects that outcomes are reported at. GET /workspaces/{workspace}/initiatives. The vendor's own note: returns every initiative; this endpoint does not paginate.

tools.name: initiative_retrieve
tools.title: Get Initiatives
tools.description: One initiative, with the state and lead a listing does not carry. GET /workspaces/{workspace}/initiatives/{initiative_id}.

tools.name: intake_list
tools.title: List Intake Queue
tools.description: A project's intake queue: work proposed from outside the project, before it is accepted. GET /workspaces/{workspace}/projects/{project_id}/intake-issues.

tools.name: intake_retrieve
tools.title: Get Intake Queue
tools.description: One intake item, which a triage decision is made on. GET /workspaces/{workspace}/projects/{project_id}/intake-issues/{workitem_id}.

tools.name: label_list
tools.title: List Labels
tools.description: A project's labels, the vocabulary its work items are filtered by. GET /workspaces/{workspace}/projects/{project_id}/labels.

tools.name: label_retrieve
tools.title: Get Labels
tools.description: One label by id, for the parent and colour a listing flattens. GET /workspaces/{workspace}/projects/{project_id}/labels/{label_id}.

tools.name: member_me
tools.title: Who Am I
tools.description: Who the stored token belongs to: the identity a write is attributed to. GET /users/me. The vendor's own note: the authenticated user. Answers for the token itself, so it names no workspace in its path.

tools.name: member_list_workspace
tools.title: List Members and Roles (workspace)
tools.description: The workspace's members, which is how a UUID in any other response is turned into a person. GET /workspaces/{workspace}/members-lite. The vendor's own note: name filters match case-insensitively and combine with AND.

tools.name: member_list_project
tools.title: List Members and Roles (project)
tools.description: A project's members, for the people a work item can be assigned to. GET /workspaces/{workspace}/projects/{project_id}/project-members.

tools.name: member_list_roles
tools.title: List Members and Roles (role catalogue)
tools.description: The role catalogue, whose slugs are the values the member listing filters on. GET /workspaces/{workspace}/roles. `namespace` selects the workspace or the project role catalogue.

tools.name: milestone_list
tools.title: List Milestones
tools.description: A project's milestones with their target dates: the readings a delivery date is checked against. GET /workspaces/{workspace}/projects/{project_id}/milestones.

tools.name: milestone_retrieve
tools.title: Get Milestones
tools.description: One milestone by id, for the fields a listing truncates. GET /workspaces/{workspace}/projects/{project_id}/milestones/{milestone_id}.

tools.name: milestone_list_workitems
tools.title: List Milestones (work items)
tools.description: What is filed under a milestone: the progress behind its target date. GET /workspaces/{workspace}/projects/{project_id}/milestones/{milestone_id}/work-items.

tools.name: module_retrieve
tools.title: Get Modules
tools.description: One module, whose status and members make it a workstream rather than a label. GET /workspaces/{workspace}/projects/{project_id}/modules/{module_id}.

tools.name: module_list_workitems
tools.title: List Modules (work items)
tools.description: What a module contains, for reading scope without loading the whole project. GET /workspaces/{workspace}/projects/{project_id}/modules/{module_id}/module-issues. `pql` is Plane's own query language for filtering and grouping.

tools.name: page_list_workitem_pages
tools.title: List Pages (pages)
tools.description: The pages attached to one work item: the notes that travel with it. GET /workspaces/{workspace}/projects/{project_id}/work-items/{workitem_id}/pages.

tools.name: project_list
tools.title: List Projects
tools.description: The project directory. It reads Plane's compact listing, which is what the vendor's own tools browse with. GET /workspaces/{workspace}/projects-lite. The vendor's own note: trimmed fields; use retrieve for full detail. The compact project listing the vendor's own tools read.

tools.name: project_retrieve
tools.title: Get Projects
tools.description: One project, for the identifier and defaults every other call is scoped by. GET /workspaces/{workspace}/projects/{project_id}.

tools.name: project_worklog_summary
tools.title: Read Projects (worklog summary)
tools.description: Total logged time per project, which no work-item listing aggregates. GET /workspaces/{workspace}/projects/{project_id}/total-worklogs.

tools.name: project_get_features
tools.title: Get Projects (features)
tools.description: Which features a project has switched on, the state `project.update-features` would change. GET /workspaces/{workspace}/projects/{project_id}/features.

tools.name: project_estimate_retrieve
tools.title: Get Project Estimates
tools.description: A project's estimate: the scale that gives its points meaning. GET /workspaces/{workspace}/projects/{project_id}/estimates. The vendor's own note: a project has at most one estimate. A project has at most one estimate, so this reads a singleton rather than a list.

tools.name: project_estimate_list_points
tools.title: List Project Estimates (points)
tools.description: The points of that estimate, which is what a work item's point value refers to. GET /workspaces/{workspace}/projects/{project_id}/estimates/{estimate_id}/estimate-points.

tools.name: release_list
tools.title: List Releases
tools.description: The workspace's releases, the container work items are shipped in. GET /workspaces/{workspace}/releases.

tools.name: release_retrieve
tools.title: Get Releases
tools.description: One release, with the dates and lead a listing leaves out. GET /workspaces/{workspace}/releases/{release_id}.

tools.name: release_get_changelog
tools.title: Get Releases (changelog)
tools.description: The release notes: read before editing them, because Plane creates the changelog empty on first read. GET /workspaces/{workspace}/releases/{release_id}/changelog. A release has one changelog; Plane creates it empty on first read.

tools.name: release_list_workitems
tools.title: List Releases (work items)
tools.description: What a release carries, which is the question a release page exists to answer. GET /workspaces/{workspace}/releases/{release_id}/work-items.

tools.name: release_tag_list
tools.title: List Release Tags
tools.description: The release tags a release can be pinned to: version identifiers, not git refs. GET /workspaces/{workspace}/releases/tags.

tools.name: release_tag_retrieve
tools.title: Get Release Tags
tools.description: One tag by id, for the commit hash a listing does not show. GET /workspaces/{workspace}/releases/tags/{tag_id}.

tools.name: state_list
tools.title: List Workflow States
tools.description: A project's workflow states, which every work item's `state` argument has to name. GET /workspaces/{workspace}/projects/{project_id}/states. The vendor's own note: workspace scope when project_id is omitted. The states of one project; the workspace-wide catalogue is not exposed. `project_id` is required: this tool is the project-scoped branch of the vendor's action, and the branch without it is not exposed.

tools.name: state_retrieve
tools.title: Get Workflow States
tools.description: One state by id: its group tells a reader whether a work item counts as started or done. GET /workspaces/{workspace}/projects/{project_id}/states/{state_id}. `project_id` is required: this tool is the project-scoped branch of the vendor's action, and the branch without it is not exposed.

tools.name: work_log_list
tools.title: List Work Logs
tools.description: Time logged against one work item, the records the project summary is computed from. GET /workspaces/{workspace}/projects/{project_id}/work-items/{workitem_id}/worklogs.

tools.name: workitem_retrieve
tools.title: Get Work Items
tools.description: One work item by UUID, with the optional expansions a search result does not carry. GET /workspaces/{workspace}/projects/{project_id}/work-items/{workitem_id}.

tools.name: workitem_retrieve_by_identifier
tools.title: Get Work Items (by identifier)
tools.description: One work item by its human key (PROJECT-123), which is how people refer to work in a conversation. GET /workspaces/{workspace}/work-items/{workitem_identifier}. The vendor's own note: identifier is PROJECT-N, e.g. ENG-42. `workitem_identifier` is the human key (PROJECT-123), not a UUID.

tools.name: workitem_search
tools.title: Search Work Items
tools.description: Workspace-wide work-item search: the only read that crosses projects. GET /workspaces/{workspace}/work-items/search.

tools.name: workitem_activity_list
tools.title: List Work Item Activity
tools.description: A work item's history, which says who changed what and when. GET /workspaces/{workspace}/projects/{project_id}/work-items/{workitem_id}/activities.

tools.name: workitem_attachment_list
tools.title: List Work Item Attachments
tools.description: The attachments on a work item, for the evidence a description only points at. GET /workspaces/{workspace}/projects/{project_id}/work-items/{workitem_id}/attachments.

tools.name: workitem_comment_list
tools.title: List Work Item Comments
tools.description: A work item's comments, which is where the decisions about it actually live. GET /workspaces/{workspace}/projects/{project_id}/work-items/{workitem_id}/comments.

tools.name: workitem_comment_retrieve
tools.title: Get Work Item Comments
tools.description: One comment by id, so a reply can quote it without fetching the whole thread. GET /workspaces/{workspace}/projects/{project_id}/work-items/{workitem_id}/comments/{comment_id}.

tools.name: workitem_link_list
tools.title: List Work Item Links
tools.description: The links hanging off a work item: pull requests, documents, dashboards. GET /workspaces/{workspace}/projects/{project_id}/work-items/{workitem_id}/links.

tools.name: workitem_link_retrieve
tools.title: Get Work Item Links
tools.description: One link by id, for the metadata Plane stores beside the URL. GET /workspaces/{workspace}/projects/{project_id}/work-items/{workitem_id}/links/{link_id}.

tools.name: workitem_property_retrieve_option
tools.title: Get Work Item Properties (option)
tools.description: One option of a project property, which is the value set a work item can be given. GET /workspaces/{workspace}/projects/{project_id}/work-item-properties/{property_id}/options/{option_id}. The options of one project's property; the workspace-wide catalogue is not exposed. `project_id` is required: this tool is the project-scoped branch of the vendor's action, and the branch without it is not exposed.

tools.name: workitem_property_get_value
tools.title: Get Work Item Properties (value)
tools.description: One custom property value on one work item: the fields Plane does not model natively. GET /workspaces/{workspace}/projects/{project_id}/work-items/{workitem_id}/work-item-properties/{property_id}/values.

tools.name: workitem_type_list
tools.title: List Work Item Types
tools.description: A project's work-item types, which are the values `type_id` accepts and the scope a property is read at. GET /workspaces/{workspace}/projects/{project_id}/work-item-types. The vendor's own note: workspace scope when project_id is omitted. The types of one project; the workspace-wide type catalogue is not exposed. `project_id` is required: this tool is the project-scoped branch of the vendor's action, and the branch without it is not exposed.

tools.name: workitem_type_retrieve
tools.title: Get Work Item Types
tools.description: One work-item type, whose properties decide what a work item of that type carries. GET /workspaces/{workspace}/projects/{project_id}/work-item-types/{workitem_type_id}. `project_id` is required: this tool is the project-scoped branch of the vendor's action, and the branch without it is not exposed.

tools.name: workspace_get_features
tools.title: Get Workspace Settings (features)
tools.description: Which workspace features are on, so a caller can tell a missing feature from a missing permission. GET /workspaces/{workspace}/features. The vendor's own note: feature flags for the current workspace. Which workspace features are switched on.

tools.name: template_list
tools.title: List Templates
tools.description: The templates a project creates pages or work items from: the shapes a team has agreed on. GET /workspaces/{workspace}/projects/{project_id}/workitems/templates | /workspaces/{workspace}/projects/{project_id}/pages/templates. One project's templates of the `kind` asked for; the workspace catalogue is not exposed. `kind` chooses the endpoint: workitem or page. `project_id` is required: this tool is the project-scoped branch of the vendor's action, and the branch without it is not exposed.

tools.name: collection_list
tools.title: List Page Collections
tools.description: The wiki collections in the workspace, which is how pages are grouped and shared. GET /workspaces/{workspace}/collections.

tools.name: collection_retrieve
tools.title: Get Page Collections
tools.description: One collection by id, with the access level its pages inherit. GET /workspaces/{workspace}/collections/{collection_id}.

tools.name: collection_list_pages
tools.title: List Page Collections (pages)
tools.description: The pages in a collection, including the nesting a search result flattens. GET /workspaces/{workspace}/collections/{collection_id}/pages.

tools.name: collection_search_pages
tools.title: Search Page Collections
tools.description: Search inside one collection, which the page listing cannot express. GET /workspaces/{workspace}/collections/{collection_id}/pages-search. The vendor's own note: pages not yet in this collection, to pick ids for add_pages.

tools.name: collection_list_members
tools.title: List Page Collections (members)
tools.description: Who a collection is shared with, and at what access level. GET /workspaces/{workspace}/collections/{collection_id}/members.
